item.description: Malaysia’s decision to pivot to Turkey for anti-ship missiles after Norway cancelled a procurement deal has offered it a way out of a costly setback, though analysts warn the episode has exposed its vulnerability to foreign export controls and highlighted the need for greater defence autonomy. The planned switch to Turkey’s Roketsan Atmaca missile system for the Malaysian navy’s littoral combat ships (LCS) reflects Kuala Lumpur’s growing defence ties with Ankara, even as questions remain over...

item.description: For years, Jensen Huang was more than Nvidia’s CEO – he was a key figure driving the artificial intelligence boom, parlaying close ties with Asian chip foundries and aggressive financial backing into an unprecedented global buildout of data centres. item.description: When massive lay-offs took place at BMW’s manufacturing base in northeast China – the German carmaker’s largest production hub worldwide – the entire city felt the shock. item.dc:creator: Brian Wong

item.description: A university student in central China has attracted attention on social media for pursuing an unusual career: shoeing racehorses. Fu Donghua, a fourth-year student at the Equestrian School of Wuhan Business University, earned his junior farrier certificate in April. According to the China Horse Industry Association, there are only 70 certified farriers in China. Fu is the youngest of them and the only one still studying at university, Jimu News reported. item.dc:creator: Cannix Yau

item.author: Elizabeth Cheung
item.dc:creator: Elizabeth Cheung
item.description: Medical devices bought from online platforms based outside Hong Kong for self-use or as personal gifts will not be targeted by a proposed law requiring medical device traders to register with the government, the city’s health minister has said. item.description: Reports that two Chinese nationals were convicted in Mongolia for making unauthorised impressions of a celebrated 2,000-year-old Han dynasty cliff inscription have ignited discussion and concern over protecting historic sites. item.author: Wynna Wong
item.dc:creator: Wynna Wong
item.description: Hong Kong has upgraded its 2026 economic growth forecast to 4.8 per cent, buoyed by recent strength in artificial intelligence-related exports, with the full-year performance expected to be the best in five years. The government’s latest projection, released on Friday, was raised from the 3.5 to 4.5 per cent range predicted in August and the 2.5 to 3.5 per cent growth it forecast in February. The city’s economy expanded by 6.5 per cent in 2021. “The Hong Kong economy is poised for a strong...

item.author: Tom Hussain
item.dc:creator: Tom Hussain
item.description: Iran’s Middle East rivals are set to accelerate their push for greater foreign and defence policy autonomy from the United States following the Democrats’ sweeping victory in the midterm elections. Key regional partners of the US – Israel, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Pakistan and Egypt – will also look to diversify their relationships beyond Washington, according to analysts. item.dc:creator: SCMP’s Asia desk

item.dc:creator: Daniel Ren
item.description: A Dutch court has rendered a ruling in favour of BYD in the Chinese electric vehicle (EV) giant’s dispute with Jaguar Land Rover (JLR) over the British luxury carmaker’s intellectual property (IP) claims. item.dc:creator: Fiona Sun

The Housing Authority said on Friday that a committee had approved two enhanced measures for subsidised sale flats. item.dc:creator: Kolette Lim

item.description: Drones could save Thai farmers fortunes in fertiliser and water management as a “super El Nino” withers harvests – while also mapping flood risks and safely scouring vast industrial sites, from oil rigs to solar farms, for damage. item.author: Ralph Jennings

item.description: A new tariff of up to 30 per cent on e-commerce goods entering Thailand may squeeze Chinese vendors, but intense price competition and their ability to keep costs low are likely to limit its impact, analysts said. item.dc:creator: Julian Ryall
